title: Plugins
description: Signed extensions that run in locked-down containers. Nothing third party loads until you trust its publisher and approve what it may do.

empty.title: No plugins match
empty.description: Try another search or category, or re-check the sources.

noSources.title: No marketplace source yet
noSources.description: Add an index source below. Each source is signed by a root key you trust.

problem.signature: The index from {{name}} failed its signature check and was ignored
problem.format: The index from {{name}} is malformed and was ignored
problem.replay: The index from {{name}} is older than one already seen and was ignored
problem.too_large: The index from {{name}} is too large and was ignored

sheet.title: Install {{name}}
sheet.description: Review exactly what this install does. The control plane checks all of it again before changing anything.
sheet.exactly: Only the abilities listed here are approved. Nothing else is granted, and the plugin is enabled once it is installed.
sheet.trustHint: The key is added to your trust list, labelled as added from the marketplace. You can remove it any time.

sources.title: Marketplace sources
sources.description: Each source is a signed plugin index. Only listings signed by the source's root key are shown.
sources.name: Name
sources.removeDescription: Its listings disappear. Plugins already installed from it keep running.

loadFailedHint: The plugin runtime needs a reachable Docker daemon. Check the control plane logs, then reload.

empty.title: No plugins installed
empty.description: Trust a publisher key first, then install a plugin package you obtained from them. See the plugins guide for the package format.

abilities.read: Receive the alert event being delivered (title, text, status, resource).
abilities.readSensitive: Also receive log excerpts attached to alerts, which can contain secrets.

approve.title: Approve {{name}}
approve.description: Review exactly what {{name}} {{version}} from {{publisher}} asks for. Nothing is granted until you tick it and approve.
approve.networkNone: No network. The plugin cannot reach anything outside its container.
approve.networkHosts: Hosts the plugin says it needs: {{hosts}}. This list is declared by the plugin, not restricted.
approve.networkNote: A plugin with any declared host currently has general network access.
approve.never: Secrets are never stored by the plugin. The credential for a channel is sent with each delivery only.
approve.needsRead: Tick the read ability: a notification plugin cannot work without it.
approve.approved: {{name}} approved. Enable it to start it.

installDialog.title: Install a plugin
installDialog.description: Paste the manifest and signature from the publisher. Installing verifies them and records the package. It does not approve or start anything.
installDialog.manifestHint: Paste the file exactly as the publisher shipped it. Any edit breaks the signature.
installDialog.noKeys: No trusted keys yet. Add the publisher's key below first.
installDialog.reviewDescription: Check who published this, whether it verifies, and exactly what it may do. Approve grants only the abilities listed.
installDialog.urlHint: A signature is read from the same URL with .sig added, unless you paste one below.
installDialog.signatureHint: Leave empty only for an unsigned package, which is refused unless the operator allows unsigned plugins.
installDialog.signatureHintUrl: Optional when a .sig file sits next to the manifest.
installDialog.installedApproved: {{name}} installed and approved. Enable it to start it.
installDialog.wrongPlugin: This manifest is for a different plugin than {{name}}.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: The plugin is stopped and deleted. Notification channels that use it will stop delivering until you pick another channel kind.

keys.title: Trusted publisher keys
keys.description: Only packages signed by a key on this list can be installed. The list starts empty.
keys.emptyDescription: Nothing third party can be installed. Verify a publisher's key with them directly, then add it.
keys.name: Publisher name
keys.removeDescription: Plugins signed by this key stop at the next supervisor pass. They stay installed.

review.unsignedWarn: Unsigned packages are not authenticated. Install only if you built it yourself.
review.panels: Adds {{count}} read-only panel(s) to this page, rendered by the dashboard from the manifest.
review.reapprovalHint: This version asks for abilities or hosts the installed one did not. Approving here grants exactly the set listed above.

panelHost.loadFailed: This panel could not load its data.
panelHost.widgetUnavailable: this part of the panel is unavailable

dns.inactive: Not used for DNS records, the built-in client writes them
dns.testOk_one: Connected, the plugin can see {{count}} zone
dns.testOk_other: Connected, the plugin can see {{count}} zones
dns.pluginOn: DNS records are now written by {{name}}
dns.builtInOn: DNS records are written by the built-in client again
dns.needsRunning: Approve and enable the plugin to test it or use it for DNS records.
